title: University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship
about: The University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship supports doctoral study, with four application rounds a year. The next round closes 1 November 2026; applicants need supervisor endorsement and international applicants are advised to apply in November or February rounds.
requirements: Supervisor endorsement required; contact proposed supervisors well before the closing date
International applicants without a previous NZ student visa are advised to apply in the 1 November or 1 February rounds
Four rounds a year; some faculties (e.g. Auckland Bioengineering Institute) list different dates
